notes: Model ids and capabilities for the hosted NVIDIA endpoint. Environment variables override default_routes; MODEL_CAPABILITIES_FILE overrides this file. Capability flags marked unverified are corrected by `python -m northforge.providers.smoke` against a live key. The hosted free tier allows 40 requests per minute per API key across all models.

models.notes: 120B MoE, 12B active. Thinking off by default (chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking). Verified 2026-09-16 over three probes: json_schema structured output succeeded twice in ~1.5 s and timed out once at 60 s; tool calls returned HTTP 500 twice and succeeded once (with thinking off). The router falls back to Lightning on both failures. nvext.guided_json is rejected by the hosted endpoint (HTTP 400, unknown field).

30B MoE, 3B active; the low-latency extraction model. Thinking off by default (same tool-call behaviour as Super). Verified: json_schema structured output and tool calls; ~0.7 s with thinking off, ~30 s with it on.

2.8T MoE, 104B active. Thinking always on. Verified 2026-09-16: json_schema structured output, tool calls, plain generation; every request took 114 to 128 s on the hosted free tier (queueing, not output length), hence the per-model timeout.

304B MoE. Independent evaluator, deliberately a different family from the planner. Verified 2026-09-16: json_schema structured output and tool calls; 115 to 119 s per request on the hosted free tier (queueing), hence the per-model timeout. Some accounts need access enabled on build.nvidia.com; the smoke command surfaces that as PROVIDER_REQUEST_REJECTED.
Fixed 2048-dimensional output; input_type must be 'query' or 'passage'; inputs validated up to 4096 tokens.
Served from ai.api.nvidia.com under /v1/retrieval/nvidia/<model>/reranking, not the OpenAI-compatible host. Query plus passage up to 10,240 tokens.
